notes.summary: The sculk of the Deep Dark listens to the battle. Loud or violent moves wake it; calm moves quiet it. At full alarm it strikes everyone on the field.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dark and Ghost moves are 1.5× stronger.
Rock and Ground moves are 1.3× stronger.
Mimicry, Camouflage and Terrain Pulse use the Dark type. Nature Power becomes Dark Pulse.
Secret Power can lower the target's Accuracy.

sections.heading: Sculk Warning
lines: One shared Warning from 0 to 4 for the whole battlefield.
Each side can change the Warning once per turn; raising and calming it share that one change. A change that would do nothing (for example calming at 0) is not used up.

A move adds Warning by the first group that applies: calming moves lower it by 1; moves with their own entry (such as Earthquake, Boomburst, Uproar and Explosion), sound moves and the Earthquake-style moves (Earth Power, Bulldoze, Rock Slide, Stone Edge and others) add 2; otherwise power decides: 90 to 149 adds 1, 150 or more adds 2.
The power counted is the move's own power before type, STAB, item and ability boosts. Spread and multi-hit moves count once, by their strongest hit.
The move only has to be carried out: a miss, Protect, immunity or absorbing ability still wakes the sculk. A move stopped before it starts (sleep, paralysis, flinch) or a charging turn does not.
Switching and fainting never reset the Warning.

sections.heading: Warning stages
lines: Warning 1 and 2 only announce that the sculk is stirring.
Warning 3: Darkness. Every accuracy check is multiplied by 0.9 (not a stat drop). Keen Eye, Compound Eyes and Illuminate ignore it. Rattled raises Speed by 1 when the Warning rises to 3.

Warning 4: the Deep Dark strikes back. Every active Pokémon that is not immune loses 20% of its maximum HP, even through Protect or a Substitute. It happens once per turn, after the move that caused it, and the Warning then drops to 1, ending the Darkness.
Immune to the strike: Soundproof, Punk Rock, Solid Rock and Ghost types. Immunity does not stop their own moves from raising the Warning.

sections.heading: Calming
lines: Calm Mind, Meditate, Flash, Rest, Aromatherapy and Lunar Blessing lower the Warning by 1.
If calming brings the Warning below 3, the Darkness lifts.

sections.heading: Magical Seed
lines: The holder's ability becomes Soundproof for the rest of its time on the field, then the seed tries to raise the Warning by 1 (it counts as the holder's side change for the turn).
